title: Leader-assignment
description: The output of the electing-leader morphism: a record naming, for a specific recognition-predicate, which entity holds the leader role in the swarm. The math: leader = arg-max over candidates of the count of verified recognition cells whose object is that candidate, across all players' settlings (recognition-discipline). Ties broken lexicographically by entity slug for determinism. When no cell with the recognition-predicate is verified anywhere in the swarm, leader is null and the assignment carries an empty candidate-list.

recognition-predicate.description: The predicate the discipline uses for recognition cells.

leader.description: The elected entity, or null if no recognition cells exist.

tally.description: Per-candidate vote totals, sorted desc by votes then asc by entity slug.
